class="stars-rating" style="width: 4.8em;"></span></span></aside></span><aside class="footer-part footer-length">1:05:57</aside><span class="fix"></span><span class="footer-part description">Professor David Diamond says you have been misled and deceived when it comes to LDL cholesterol and statins.
